stage_name_zh: 阶段 4：顶会论文、具身智能/生成建模、学术演讲与全周期综合复习（Day 76–116）
learning_objectives_zh: 通过 8 个核心词群（涵盖今日 28 个目标词条）掌握熟悉词汇的学术熟词生义（Polysemy）、一词多义边界、可数/及物性变化与自然搭配。
掌握句子成分精细分析（主、谓、宾、表、定、状、同位语）与核心语法：【G014】情态动词、确定性梯度与科学谨慎表达（Epistemic Hedging）；【G019】比较结构、拉丁比较级（superior/prior to）与比较维度限定（in terms of）。
掌握学术表达模式：【EP020】生成模型与概率预测：分布校准、不确定性量化与尾部风险，彻底消除头重脚轻、口语化、过度表达与空洞 AI 套话。
完成 36 道高密度、单点聚焦的实战练习，确保今日每个词条均获得至少 3 次训练（含至少 2 次主动输出）。

grammar_instruction.name: 情态动词、确定性梯度与科学谨慎表达（Epistemic Hedging）
grammar_instruction.explanation_zh: 科学写作要求结论的语气强度与实验/数据证据的完备度严格对齐。通过情态动词（may, might, can, could）、认知副词（arguably, apparently, plausibly, relatively, typically）及谨慎动词（suggest, indicate, point to, appear to）控制断言边界。
rules: 当存在未测混杂（unmeasured confounding）、小样本或仿真环境限制时，必须使用 may be attributable to / suggests that / supports a tentative conclusion。
禁止在经验研究中滥用 irrefutable, undeniable, inevitable, universal, conclusively prove；只有经核实的数学反例推翻全称命题时才可用 disprove / irrefutable。
examples: The observed discrepancy may be attributable to differences in measurement procedures.
A distributional forecast is arguably more informative when decisions depend on tail risk.
The verified counterexample provides irrefutable evidence that the universal mathematical claim is false.
common_errors: 在改写或总结时删去原句的 may / arguably / in this sample 等限定词，造成过度绝对化。

grammar_instruction.name: 比较结构、拉丁比较级（superior/prior to）与比较维度限定（in terms of）
grammar_instruction.explanation_zh: 科学比较必须做到：(1) 比较主体语法同构，(2) 明确比较指标与条件（in terms of / with respect to / under comparable conditions），(3) 正确使用拉丁比较级与类比结构。
rules: superior to, inferior to, prior to, analogous to, akin to 一律用介词 to，严禁用 than。
声明某方法更优（superior / optimal / outperform）时，必须限定评估指标与数据集范围，禁止无条件宣称“处处最优”。
examples: The method was superior to the baseline on this metric, but other outcomes were not assessed.
The procedure is akin to stratified sampling, although the allocation rule differs.
The two protocols differ with respect to measurement error.
common_errors: 省略比较基准（baseline）或评价维度。

grammar_instruction.name: 句法歧义消除（介词短语附着、修辞辖域与比较基准排歧）
grammar_instruction.explanation_zh: 消除句子中的结构性多解（Structural Ambiguity），确保读者无需猜测修饰语究竟挂靠在哪个词上。
rules: 调整介词短语位置或改写为定语从句，消除“V + NP + PP”中的 PP 附着歧义。
明确区分绝对差值（in absolute terms）与相对变化（in relative terms），并交代基准分母（denominator）。
examples: The absolute difference was reported alongside the relative change.
common_errors: 修饰语远离核心词导致语义滑稽或产生双重解释。

expression_pattern_instruction.name: 生成模型与概率预测：分布校准、不确定性量化与尾部风险
expression_pattern_instruction.template: A probabilistic/generative model assigns probabilities to possible outcomes, allowing us to quantify uncertainty and evaluate both calibration and sharpness.
expression_pattern_instruction.explanation_zh: 用于生成模型（Generative Models）与概率预测论文，阐述为何需要学习完整条件分布而非单一点估计（point estimate）。
examples: A distributional forecast is arguably more informative when decisions depend on tail risk.
Forecast calibration concerns statistical consistency between forecasts and observations.
common_errors: 将高集中度（sharpness）误认为已经过概率校准（calibrated）。

expression_pattern_instruction.name: 六级与雅思托福（CET-6 / IELTS / TOEFL）议论文：去模板化“主张—机制—具体实例—让步”结构
expression_pattern_instruction.template: While [Concession: competing view/cost], [Main Claim: policy/technology] can [Verb: facilitate/mitigate] [Outcome] by [Concrete Mechanism], as illustrated by [Specific Real-World Case].
expression_pattern_instruction.explanation_zh: 专为六级、雅思 Task 2 与托福独立写作设计：告别陈腐套话，用一句话完成让步对比，紧接着给出具体作用机制与可信实例。
examples: While expanding public transport requires substantial infrastructure investment, subsidising bus fares can facilitate access to education for low-income students by reducing daily commuting costs.
Asynchronous online courses allow working adults to study at their own pace; nevertheless, they cannot wholly replace face-to-face seminars that stimulate spontaneous debate.
common_errors: 只写夸张口号（如 *Online education is a double-edged sword and plays a vital role*）而不展开具体原因机制与实例。
